services.name: Sunset Sail
services.desc: Our sunset cruise / sunset sail begins out of the historic Schooner Wharf bar in Old Key West. As we sail out of Man O' War harbor, we'll pass Sunset Isle, Mallory Square, Fort Zachary Taylor, Key West beaches. You might see dolphins, sea turtles, and other marine life. Join the crew in sailing the ship, or relax and enjoy delicious hors d'oeuvres, very nice wines and beer's, mimosa's, and champagne are all included with your cruise. Mimosa's, incredible merlots and pinot grigios, assorted beers, focaccia sandwiches from Duettos restaurant Sandwiches purchased daily for passengers already booked Approximate length of cruise: 2 hours Sail times vary according to the setting sun.
